from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

# Let us find exact pixel coordinates in obs_0001, obs_0008, obs_0020
for name, img_id in [("obs_0001", 1), ("obs_0008", 8), ("obs_0020", 20)]:
    arr = np.array(Image.open(f"/work/observations/{name}.png"))
    # Plant pot
    pot_m = (arr[:, :, 0] > 140) & (arr[:, :, 0] < 190) & (arr[:, :, 1] > 60) & (arr[:, :, 1] < 100) & (arr[:, :, 2] < 50)
    # Stool top
    stool_m = (arr[:, :, 0] > 120) & (arr[:, :, 0] < 160) & (arr[:, :, 1] > 50) & (arr[:, :, 1] < 90) & (arr[:, :, 2] < 40)
    # Floor lamp base
    base_m = (arr[:, :, 0] > 60) & (arr[:, :, 0] < 90) & (arr[:, :, 1] > 70) & (arr[:, :, 1] < 100) & (arr[:, :, 2] > 80) & (arr[:, :, 2] < 120)
    # Lamp shade
    shade_m = (arr[:, :, 0] > 180) & (arr[:, :, 1] > 170) & (arr[:, :, 2] > 100) & (arr[:, :, 2] < 160)
    
    print(f"--- {name} ---")
    for obj_name, m in [("pot", pot_m), ("shade", shade_m)]:
        y, x = np.where(m)
        if len(x) > 0:
            print(f"  {obj_name}: center_x = {x.mean():.1f}, center_y = {y.mean():.1f}")
'", "description": "Find centers for pot and shade"}
